caption: Fix #1136: a disengaging unit's regiment position now anchors on its real contact-resisted front ranks. Infantry 1 gets a plain move order straight through the held Infantry 2 -- Infantry 1 never fights back (it takes real one-sided casualties from Infantry 2 defending its ground, identically before and after this fix; only the geometry changes). Before this fix, Infantry 1's own kinematic anchor rode straight through the held line, crossing past it by the end of the clip. After it, the advance genuinely arrests at contact and the block compresses against the line instead.
